# Events

Events and other top-level lines: what starts a trigger. 146 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Block break {#break}

```carve
on break
on block break
on mine
```

A block is broken. Has `player` (`<none>` when no player broke it). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on break:
    if player does not have permission "builder":
        cancel event
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Block place {#place}

```carve
on place
on block place
```

A player places a block. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on place:
    add 1 to {placed::%player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Chat {#chat}

```carve
on chat
on player chat
```

A player sends a chat message. Has `player` and `message`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on chat:
    if message is "help":
        send "Try /rules" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Click {#click}

```carve
on click
on (right click|rightclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
on (left click|leftclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
```

A player clicks air or a block. `with` checks the held item, `on` the clicked block, in any order. Has `clicked block` (also `event-block`). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on right click with blaze rod:
    send "Whoosh!" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Command {#command}

```carve
command [/]<name> [<type>] [[<type>]]
```

Adds a script command. Entries: `permission:`, `description:` and the required `trigger:`. Argument types: `<text>`, `<number>`, `<player>`; `[ ]` makes one optional. New commands need a server restart.

```carve
command /greet <player> [<text>]:
    permission: greet
    trigger:
        send "%player% says hi!" to arg-1
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [commands](../commands.md)

## Consume {#consume}

```carve
on consume
on eat
on drink
on item consume
on player consume
```

A player eats or drinks. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on eat:
    send "yum" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Craft {#craft}

```carve
on craft
on item craft
on craft item
on player craft
```

A player crafts an item. Has `event-recipe`, `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on craft:
    send "crafted %event-item%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Damage {#damage}

```carve
on damage
on damage of player
on player damage
```

A player takes damage. Has `damage`, `attacker` (`<none>` for mobs and falls) and `victim`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on damage:
    if damage > 10:
        cancel event
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Death {#death}

```carve
on death
on death of player
on player death
```

A player dies. Has `player` and `victim`; `attacker` is always `<none>` here. Cancelling stops Pumpkin's death handling but leaves 0 health.

```carve
on death of player:
    broadcast "%player% died"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Drop {#drop}

```carve
on drop
on item drop
on player drop
on drop item
on player drop item
```

A player drops an item. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on drop:
    if event-item is diamond:
        cancel event
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Flight toggle {#flight_toggle}

```carve
on flight toggle
on toggle flight
on player toggle flight
```

A player starts or stops flying. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on flight toggle:
    send "wheee" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)

## Gamemode change {#gamemode_change}

```carve
on gamemode change [to %text%]
on game mode change
on player gamemode change
on player game mode change
```

A player's game mode changes. Has `old gamemode`, `new gamemode` and `player`. `to creative` filters by the new mode. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on gamemode change to creative:
    send "creative on" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Inventory click {#inventory_click}

```carve
on inventory click
on inventory clicking
on inventory click event
```

A player clicks a slot in an open inventory, any window. Has `clicked slot`, `clicked item` and `click type`. Cancel it so players cannot take menu items.

```carve
on inventory click:
    if clicked slot is 4:
        cancel event
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Inventory close {#inventory_close}

```carve
on inventory close
on inventory closing
on inventory close event
```

A player closes an inventory. Cannot be cancelled.

```carve
on inventory close:
    send "Bye." to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Join {#join}

```carve
on join
on player join
on login
```

A player joins the server. Has `player`.

```carve
on join:
    send title "Welcome, %player%!" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Level change {#level_change}

```carve
on level change
on player level change
```

A player's level changes. Has `old level`, `new level` and `player`. Cannot be cancelled.

```carve
on level change:
    if new level > old level:
        send "level up!" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Load {#load}

```carve
on load
on script load
on server start
on skript load
```

Runs after scripts load, and after every successful `/carve reload`. No `player`. Cannot be cancelled.

```carve
on load:
    if {spawn} is not set:
        set {spawn} to location(0, 64, 0)
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Mob spawn {#mob_spawn}

```carve
on mob spawn [of %text%]
on spawn [of %text%]
on creature spawn
on entity spawn
```

A mob spawns. Has `event-entity`, `event-location` and `spawn reason`. `of zombie` filters by entity type. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on spawn of zombie:
    broadcast "a zombie spawned"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Options {#options}

```carve
options:
```

A block of named constants, used as `{@name}` anywhere in the same file.

```carve
options:
    prefix: &8[&6Shop&8]&r
on join:
    send "{@prefix} Welcome" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## Periodic (every) {#every}

```carve
every %timespan%
```

Runs on a timer counted in server ticks from plugin load. No `player`. A `wait` inside does not delay the next round.

```carve
every 5 minutes:
    broadcast "&eDon't forget to vote!"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Pick up {#pick_up}

```carve
on pick up
on pickup
on item pickup
on item pick up
on player pickup
on player pick up
on pick up item
```

A player picks up an item. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on pick up:
    send "you got %event-item%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Projectile hit {#projectile_hit}

```carve
on projectile hit
on projectile land
```

A projectile hits something. Has `event-location` and `hit player` (`<none>` when it hit something else). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on projectile hit:
    strike lightning effect at event-location
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Quit {#quit}

```carve
on quit
on player quit
on leave
on disconnect
```

A player leaves. The player is already gone, so `%player%` works until the first `wait` but effects on them do nothing.

```carve
on quit:
    broadcast "%player% left the server"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Respawn {#respawn}

```carve
on respawn
on player respawn
```

A player respawns. Cannot be cancelled.

```carve
on respawn:
    send "Welcome back" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Sneak toggle {#sneak_toggle}

```carve
on sneak toggle
on toggle sneak
on player toggle sneak
```

A player starts or stops sneaking. State conditions show the state before the change. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on sneak toggle:
    if player is sneaking:
        send "standing up" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)

## Sprint toggle {#sprint_toggle}

```carve
on sprint toggle
on toggle sprint
on player toggle sprint
```

A player starts or stops sprinting. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on sprint toggle:
    send "zoom" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)
